description: Localization (i18n) JavaScript file for the Select2 library, providing Czech translations for UI messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message when input is longer than maximum, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message when input is shorter than minimum, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message when maximum selection limit is reached, with pluralization.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message when search is in progress.
